qa.title: QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
qa.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions about Nightfall Squadron

faqs.question: How can I join Zjednoczona Polska Korona?
faqs.answer: To join our clan, you need to join our Discord server (https://discord.gg/A3wE5mGryB) and then create a ticket named "Recruitment", answer 6 questions, and wait for an administrator or a higher rank to accept you.

faqs.question: What requirements do I need to meet?
faqs.answer: Requirements may vary depending on the role you want to take. Generally, you need to be active, respect the rules, and have a microphone for server communication. If you don't have a microphone, you can use the TTS bot (Text to Speak).

faqs.question: How do I report a problem or regulation violation?
faqs.answer: You can report an issue through the ticket system on our Discord server or directly inform the administration. Provide as detailed information as possible about the incident.

faqs.question: Can I appeal a ban?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can appeal a ban through the appeal page that is located in the announcement.

faqs.question: What language is used on the server?
faqs.answer: We mainly use only Polish, because this is a Polish-only community together with the clan — not an international one, etc.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum age requirement?
faqs.answer: While we don't have a strictly defined minimum age requirement, we recommend that members be at least 16 years old and demonstrate maturity — but only for the clan. If you want to be part of the community, you must be 13 years old, unless you are mature for your age, then you can join the clan.

faqs.question: How do I get promoted to a higher rank?
faqs.answer: Promotion depends on your activity, engagement, and demonstrated skills. The administration will observe your progress and consider promotion at the appropriate time.

faqs.question: Can I become a moderator or administrator?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is possible. You need to demonstrate appropriate skills, trustworthiness, and be an active team member. The right person from administration should propose you.

about.title: WHAT IS ZPK?
about.subtitle: Learn about our history, mission, and how to join our community
about.whoAreWeContent: Zjednoczona Polska Korona (ZPK) is the first Polish clan in the game Wanted. We are committed to creating a friendly, strong, and disciplined community.
about.ourMissionContent: The mission of Zjednoczona Polska Korona is to build a strong, organized, and mutually respectful clan community. We strive to:
about.mission2: Arming members (if they don't have enough money for better weapons)
about.requirement2: Have at least 200-800k cash in your account.
about.valuesIntro: Zjednoczona Polska Korona operations are based on the following fundamental values:
about.value1Content: -- We respect every member of our community regardless of their position.
about.value2Content: -- We believe that discipline is the key to success and harmony in the community.
about.value3Content: -- We work together for the common good and support each other.
about.value4Content: -- We never give up after defeats. Every loss is a lesson that brings us closer to victory.
about.value5Content: -- Every member is committed to the actions of Zjednoczona Polska Korona
about.structureContent: Zjednoczona Polska Korona has a well-defined structure with various roles and positions. From Faction Command at the top to Trial Moderators, every role is important and supports the overall functioning of the organization.
about.structureContent2: To learn more about our roles and staff members, visit the 'Staff' page.
about.howToJoinContent: To join us, you need to meet all 3 requirements. Here are the 3 steps to join:
about.step3: Next, go to the "help" channel and click "contact management", choose the "Recruitment" category and answer 6 questions.
about.step4: Final step: you become an official member of the Zjednoczona Polska Korona clan! :D
about.communityContent: Our server works in a community + clan model. Don't want to join the clan? No problem - you can be just a community member. However, you must pass 3 verifications:
about.communityStep1: Verification via Bloxlink (linking your Discord account with Roblox).
about.communityStep2: Wait 3 days to unlock field channels.
about.communityStep3: Wait 7 days to unlock most channels (except clan and staff channels).
about.contactContent: If you have questions or want to contact the administration, you can do so via:
about.contactRoblox: Roblox: Direct message to an administration member
about.contactWebsite: This website: Use the contact option (if available)

terms.title: TERMS OF SERVICE
terms.subtitle: Rules for using the site and how data is processed
terms.notice: If you have questions about these terms, contact the administration through our Discord server.

sections.title: Acceptance of terms
body: By using this Zjednoczona Polska Korona (ZPK) website, you accept these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the site.
The site is intended for members of the Wanted (Roblox) game community and people interested in joining the faction.

sections.title: Discord login
body: Access to selected sections (KOS, War Logs) requires logging in through Discord. Login uses the OAuth2 standard — your Discord password never reaches our site or servers.
When logging in we receive: your user ID, username, and the list of servers you belong to (to verify ZPK server membership).

sections.title: Permitted use
body: You agree to use the site in accordance with the server rules and the law. Prohibited: hacking attempts, scanning, tampering with the code, impersonating other users, and abusing administrative features.
The site monitors unauthorized access attempts (security layer) and may log IP addresses for protective purposes.

sections.title: Data and intellectual property
body: Site content (texts, graphics, logo) belongs to Zjednoczona Polska Korona. Copying content without permission is prohibited.
Data entered by administrators (e.g. KOS entries, war reports) is faction property and may be edited or removed at any time.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
body: The site is provided "as is". We do not guarantee continuous operation, absence of errors, or availability at all times.
ZPK is not liable for damages resulting from the use of the site, including loss of session data or service unavailability.

sections.title: Changes to terms
body: We reserve the right to change these terms at any time. The current version is always available on this page.
Continuing to use the site after changes means acceptance of the new terms.

privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.subtitle: What data we collect, why, and how you can delete it
privacy.safeBody: This site does NOT collect your password, email address, or payment data. Discord login uses the secure OAuth standard — Discord never shares your password with us.
privacy.notice: You have the right to log out at any time and request deletion of your data — message the administration on Discord.

sections.title: What data we collect
body: When logging in through Discord we receive: your user ID, username, and whether you belong to the ZPK server.
The login session (OAuth token) is stored only in your browser (localStorage) and expires automatically after 12 hours.
The hosting server (Netlify) and the site's security layer may log IP addresses and basic traffic information for protective and diagnostic purposes.
If you are an administrator, we check your roles on the Discord server to verify permissions (only the fact that you hold an admin role — we do not store the full role list).

sections.title: Why we do this
body: Data is used solely for: membership verification, granting access to KOS and War Logs sections, recognizing administrators, and protecting the site from abuse.
We do not sell, share, or expose your data to third parties. The only external services are Discord (authorization), Netlify (hosting) and Ably (live notifications — no personal data).

sections.title: Where it is stored
body: Session token: in your browser (localStorage). Removing it = logging out.
Administrator data (permissions): verified live through the Discord API — we keep no copy.
Security logs: with the hosting provider (Netlify) for a short period, for technical purposes.

sections.title: How to delete your data
body: Log out with the menu button (clears the session from the browser) or clear localStorage in browser settings.
To request deletion of any data we might have stored, message the administration on the ZPK Discord server — we will respond within 14 days.

regulations.title: Regulations of Nightfall Squadron Server
regulations.warning: Anyone who breaks rules will face consequences, such as being muted for a certain number of hours, banned, or kicked off server. If you give out someone else's personal information, you can expect to receive a permanent ban and be added to ⁠𝙺𝙾𝚂.
regulations.highlight: Some rules will be highlighted to avoid breaking any regulations and ending up on the kos-list.
regulations.voiceChatRulesTitle: Section 2: General rules in voice chat

general: Respect others: Behave respectfully toward all members of the server, regardless of their age, gender, origin or views.
Culture toward administration and players: Insulting higher ranks, administration and each other is prohibited. This rule applies equally to both members and moderators/admins.
Don't spam: Don't send excessive messages, don't flood, don't share unnecessary links and don't abuse CAPS LOCK.
Privacy protection: Absolute prohibition on sharing information that could identify you or other users (phone numbers, email addresses, bank details, IP addresses, etc.).
NSFW / Gore content ban: Don't share sexual content, violent content, vulgar content or content with a high degree of brutality.
Advertising ban: Don't advertise your products, services, other websites or Discord servers without permission. Administration must first obtain the Owner's consent before posting any invites.
Copyright: Don't share content that infringes on the copyrights of others.
Impersonation ban: Don't impersonate other users or administration members.
voice: Respect on VC: Behave respectfully toward your fellow speakers.
Culture of expression: Avoid excessive profanity, hate speech and discriminatory statements. (Appropriate battle slang from Wanted! is allowed, but no toxicity!).
Don't shout: Speak calmly and clearly into the microphone, respect other players' ears.
Soundboard / sound spam ban: Don't constantly play music, binders or other annoying recordings without explicit consent from others in the channel.
Don't interrupt: If someone is speaking (especially during in-game action planning), wait for your turn. Don't cut anyone off.
Respect the space: If you're not participating in the conversation or there's noise in the background, mute your microphone.
NSFW playback ban: Playing sexually, violently or extremely offensive sounds on VC is prohibited.
Recording ban: Absolutely no recording of voice channel conversations without explicit consent from all participants.

changes.title: Global session expiry (12h)
changes.description: New global session context (SessionContext) — an expired session is detected and removed automatically (1s ticker), without waiting for a visit to KOS/WarLogs. The avatar badge, timer, and admin button disappear live, and AuthGuard and DevGuard now enforce the TTL on the dev site as well.

changes.title: Fixed infinite loading screen on the dev site
changes.description: React.lazy was created inside a component (a new fetch on every render → infinite spinner), and DevGuard returned null instead of false when no session existed. Both are fixed — logged-out users now see the LoginPage instead of a stuck loading screen.

changes.title: Redirect /api/* → Netlify functions
changes.description: The frontend called functions via /api/*, but Netlify only exposes them under /.netlify/functions/* — every endpoint (verify-admin, kos-store, announce, ably-token-request) returned 404. Added a redirect in netlify.toml; this unblocks the KOS admin panel, realtime (LIVE), and announcements.

changes.title: Fixed freeze after logout
changes.description: Logout used location.href = '#/' — if you were already on the home page the hash didn't change and no reload happened. Now a full reload to a clean URL (location.replace); no more stuck loading screen after logout.

changes.title: Extended admin system: multiple servers + auto-admin
changes.description: ZPK_ADMIN_ROLE_IDS now supports roles bound to specific servers (guildId:roleId) plus a new ZPK_GUILD_IDS variable. A server owner or anyone with the ADMINISTRATOR permission gets the admin panel automatically — no role IDs needed, even without a bot token.

changes.title: Changelog DEV versions protected
changes.description: The DEV Versions tab is only visible to members of the development server (is_dev_member). Others see a styled lock screen with a Discord login button; after logging in the tab unlocks immediately.

changes.title: Realtime status diagnostics
changes.description: The STANDBY pill now shows the reason for a failed connection in a tooltip (e.g. ABLY_NOT_CONFIGURED, token error) and a CONNECTING state while connecting — no more guessing what is wrong.

changes.title: Local dev via netlify-cli
changes.description: New npm run dev script launches CRA together with Netlify functions (netlify dev) — /api/* works locally just like in production, and KOS sees admin verification right away.

changes.title: Token Auth for realtime (Ably)
changes.description: The frontend no longer holds any Ably key — it connects via short-lived tokens (TTL 1h, read-only channel access) issued by the new /api/ably-token-request function. The ROOT key never leaves the backend, and a captured token cannot publish.

changes.title: Removed Ably key from the production bundle
changes.description: The subscribe-only key ended up in the build through .env.local. The dev key now lives in .env.development.local (loaded only on npm start) — the production bundle is clean and no key leaks into the site code.

changes.title: Realtime connection fix
changes.description: Removed a dead variable in the realtime layer (ESLint warning) and made the switch between token auth and the localhost key fallback more stable.

changes.title: Faster startup and smooth navigation
changes.description: Lazy-loading of all subpages (code-splitting — smaller initial bundle), automatic scroll-to-top on page change, and smooth page transition animations.

changes.title: User badge: avatar + session timer
changes.description: The navbar now shows the Discord avatar, a live countdown of session expiry (12h), and a global realtime status pill (LIVE/STANDBY).

changes.title: KOS: COPY NAME and sorting
changes.description: One-click copy of a target's nickname to the clipboard, plus list sorting (A-Z / Z-A) next to the PERSONAL/FACTION filters.

changes.description: Admin role is verified on every page entry (a Discord role grant works without logging out) and the list refreshes instantly via Ably.

changes.description: Faction announcement history (from Netlify Blobs) for every visitor, plus an in-site announcement form for administrators (INFO/WARNING/CRITICAL).
